margin_call_leverage_mul.description: Multiplier for calculating margin call leverage.

max_initial_leverage.description: Maximum leverage that the user can use for margin trading.

force_close_fee.description: Fee for the force closing of the position.

enabled.description: Flag indicating whether the margin trading is available.

active.description: Flag indicating whether any positions comply with the parameters (including not yet opened).

limit_base.description:
An absolute maximum that a position value can reach.

Conditions: risk limits exist

limit_power.description:
Power which determines the influence of the leverage on the risk limit value.

Conditions: risk limits exist

unlimited_threshold.description:
Position leverage below which the risk limit is not calculated.

Conditions: risk limits exist
